newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police detain Basque guerrilla suspect.
newsitem.headline: French police detain Basque guerrilla suspect.

text.p: French police have detained a suspected member of the Basque separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) along with a woman companion, police said on Tuesday.

Juan Maria Insausti Mugica, also known as "Karpov", had been on the run for five years. Police said he was armed on Tuesday morning when he was seized by anti-terrorism police in the southwestern town of Bordeaux.
On Monday police had found a cache of arms belonging to suspected Basque rebels, including guns in a trunk dumped in a tributary of the Adour river at Sainte-Marie-de-Gosse, in south-west France.
Paramilitary gendarmes had earlier found a case containing handguns and bullets on the river bank nearby.
ETA, battling the government in neighbouring Spain, have killed nearly 800 people in a drive for full Basque independence begun in 1968.
